name: Breslin Potted Chicken
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: two and one-half tablespoons melted butter
ingredients.originalText: two and one-half tablespoons melted butter

ingredients.name: one-third cup canned string beans, cut in small pieces
ingredients.originalText: one-third cup canned string beans, cut in small pieces

ingredients.name: one-third cup cooked carrot, cut in fancy shapes
ingredients.originalText: one-third cup cooked carrot, cut in fancy shapes

instructions.text: Dress, clean, and truss a broiler.
Put in a casserole dish, brush over with two and one-half tablespoons melted butter, put on cover, and bake twenty minutes; then add one cup stock and cook until chicken is tender.

Thicken stock with one tablespoon, each, butter and flour cooked together, and add one-half cup cooked potato balls, one-third cup canned string beans, cut in small pieces, one-third cup cooked carrot, cut in fancy shapes, and six sautéd mushroom caps.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Dress, clean, and truss a broiler.
2. Put in a casserole dish, brush over with two and one-half tablespoons melted butter, put on cover, and bake twenty minutes; then add one cup stock and cook until chicken is tender.
3. Thicken stock with one tablespoon, each, butter and flour cooked together, and add one-half cup cooked potato balls, one-third cup canned string beans, cut in small pieces, one-third cup cooked carrot, cut in fancy shapes, and six sautéd mushroom caps.
